title: EGCG inhibits hepatic stellate cell activity and liver fibrosis by targeting the MDM2/MUC5AC-mediated TGF-beta1/Smad signaling pathway.
authors: Yang, Longbao; Chen, Fenrong; Li, Xiong; Sun, Xiaoke; Li, Hong; Shi, Haitao; Zhao, Gang
one_liner_zh: 研究EGCG通过MDM2/MUC5AC轴调控TGF-beta1/Smad信号通路抑制肝纤维化，属于肝星状细胞生物学与信号转导研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To investigate the intervention effect of epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) on liver fibrosis and its underlying molecular mechanisms. METHODS: A mouse model of liver fibrosis induced by a high-fat diet was established, with groups divided into normal control, high-fat diet (HF) group, and HF + EGCG groups (low, medium, and high doses). The therapeutic effect of EGCG on liver fibrosis was evaluated by liver pathological scoring, detection of serum biochemical indicators, analysis of fibrotic markers, and Western blot for fibrotic protein expression. LX-2 cells were cultured in vitro and activated by TGF-beta1. Molecular biology experiments (RT-qPCR, Western blot, immunofluorescence, co-immunoprecipitation, etc.) were used to explore the effects of EGCG on LX-2 cell activation, proliferation, migration, and its regulation of the TGF-beta/Smad signaling pathway. Ubiquitination assays, molecular docking, and enzyme inhibitor interventions were performed to clarify the regulatory mechanism of EGCG on MUC5AC stability and its interaction with MDM2. Gene silencing/overexpression techniques were used to verify the critical role of the MDM2/MUC5AC axis in EGCG's anti-fibrotic effect. RESULTS: In vivo experiments showed that EGCG dose-dependently improved liver histological damage in high-fat diet-fed mice, reduced serum levels of ALT, AST, and TBil, increased albumin and prothrombin time, decreased the expression of fibrotic markers such as hyaluronic acid (HA) and laminin (LN), and inhibited the expression of fibrotic proteins including alpha-SMA and collagen I. In vitro experiments confirmed that EGCG reduced activation, proliferation, and migration of LX-2 cells by inhibiting the TGF-beta1/Smad signaling pathway (downregulating Smad2/3 phosphorylation and upregulating Smad7). Mechanistically, EGCG targeted and bound to MDM2, inhibiting MDM2-mediated ubiquitination and degradation of MUC5AC, thereby increasing MUC5AC protein stability. MUC5AC directly interacted with TGF-beta1, further inhibiting the activation of the TGF-beta1/Smad pathway. Additionally, overexpression of MDM2 reversed the upregulation of MUC5AC and the anti-fibrotic effect of EGCG, while supplementation of MUC5AC restored the intervention effect of EGCG, confirming that EGCG exerts its function through the MDM2/MUC5AC axis. CONCLUSION: EGCG targets MDM2 to prevent MUC5AC from ubiquitination and degradation. The upregulated MUC5AC binds to TGF-beta1 and inhibits the TGF-beta1/Smad signaling pathway, thereby suppressing hepatic stellate cell activation and liver fibrosis progression. This study provides new potential targets and experimental basis for the prevention and treatment of liver fibrosis.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯（EGCG）对肝纤维化的干预效果及其潜在分子机制。方法：建立高脂饮食诱导的小鼠肝纤维化模型，分组为正常对照组、高脂饮食（HF）组及HF+EGCG组（低、中、高剂量）。通过肝脏病理评分、血清生化指标检测、纤维化标志物分析及Western blot检测纤维化蛋白表达，评估EGCG对肝纤维化的治疗效果。体外培养LX-2细胞，并用TGF-beta1激活。采用分子生物学实验（RT-qPCR、Western blot、免疫荧光、共免疫沉淀等）探讨EGCG对LX-2细胞激活、增殖、迁移的影响及其对TGF-beta/Smad信号通路的调控。通过泛素化实验、分子对接及酶抑制剂干预，阐明EGCG对MUC5AC稳定性的调控机制及其与MDM2的相互作用。利用基因沉默/过表达技术验证MDM2/MUC5AC轴在EGCG抗纤维化效应中的关键作用。结果：体内实验显示，EGCG剂量依赖性地改善高脂饮食喂养小鼠的肝脏组织学损伤，降低血清ALT、AST和TBil水平，增加白蛋白和凝血酶原时间，减少透明质酸（HA）和层粘连蛋白（LN）等纤维化标志物的表达，并抑制alpha-SMA和胶原I等纤维化蛋白的表达。体外实验证实，EGCG通过抑制TGF-beta1/Smad信号通路（下调Smad2/3磷酸化并上调Smad7）减少LX-2细胞的激活、增殖和迁移。机制上，EGCG靶向结合MDM2，抑制MDM2介导的MUC5AC泛素化降解，从而增加MUC5AC蛋白稳定性。MUC5AC直接与TGF-beta1相互作用，进一步抑制TGF-beta1/Smad通路的激活。此外，MDM2过表达逆转了EGCG对MUC5AC的上调及其抗纤维化效应，而MUC5AC补充则恢复了EGCG的干预效果，证实EGCG通过MDM2/MUC5AC轴发挥作用。结论：EGCG靶向MDM2，防止MUC5AC发生泛素化降解。上调的MUC5AC与TGF-beta1结合并抑制TGF-beta1/Smad信号通路，从而抑制肝星状细胞激活和肝纤维化进展。本研究为肝纤维化的防治提供了新的潜在靶点和实验依据。
